transcript.message:
Hi Carlos, thanks for returning the call. I appreciate you taking the time—especially for being proactive in reaching out after receiving our letter. My name is Alex Carter, and I’m with the customer resolution team at ClearPath Financial Solutions. 

Just so you know, this call is from a debt collector, and I’m reaching out regarding your account with us, specifically a past-due balance on a loan that was originally held with our lending partner. The purpose of my call today isn’t to pressure you, but to better understand your situation and see how we can work together to find a manageable path forward.

Before we go further, may I confirm this is the correct contact number and that you’re the right person to speak with about this account? And do you have a moment now to go over things, or would you prefer to schedule a better time?
